detailed_description: Compound Interest Calculator estimates how an initial balance can grow over a chosen number of years. Enter the starting investment, annual interest rate, investment period, compounding frequency, and optional regular contribution, then calculate the final amount, total contributions, and total interest. The result includes a simple year-by-year balance view so you can compare how the projected balance changes over time.
usage_steps: Choose the investment period in years
Select compounding frequency (daily, monthly, quarterly, annually)
View final amount, total contributions, total interest, and yearly balance bars
usage_examples: Estimate how a starting balance could grow over a fixed period.
Compare daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual compounding inputs.
Check how adding monthly or annual contributions changes the projected final amount.
